mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, we are looking at clear skies over Badger Prairie County Park with a current temperature of 62 degrees. The moon is in a waxing gibbous phase, and as we look toward morning, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 55 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona is accepting applications for an Engineering Technician position to oversee construction projects through September 20. Additionally, the city has implemented a rain barrel rebate program offering up to 30 dollars back for property owners, and the council recently adjusted sewer and stormwater rates to ensure our utilities remain self-supporting.

There is a lot happening today, including live music at Bailey's Run, the Verona Ice Arena, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness, followed by trivia nights and the downtown farmer's market next week.
A notable incident occurred on August 15 when officers responded to a vehicle stopped in the road; the driver was arrested for an O W I after she was found asleep behind the wheel.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew. The store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM tomorrow, when the flavor will be Dark Chocolate PB Crunch.
